$description: BackToTop (platform/components/BackToTop, library wave 5, lane C): its component tokens. The button is Button's (secondary, icon only, or ghost inline); these place the floating one and set when it shows.

back-to-top-reveal-distance.$description: BackToTop: how far the page scrolls before the floating button shows (one window height: the sentinel's height).

back-to-top-sentinel-width.$description: BackToTop: the sentinel's width (a hairline: it only has to intersect).

back-to-top-inset-block-end.$description: BackToTop floating: the space from the window's bottom edge.

back-to-top-inset-inline-end.$description: BackToTop floating: the space from the window's end edge.

back-to-top-shadow.$description: BackToTop floating: the shadow that lifts it above the content (the menu elevation, as the other floating surfaces).

back-to-top-z-index.$description: BackToTop floating: above the content, under menus and dialogs (the sticky layer).

back-to-top-duration.$description: BackToTop floating: the fade when it shows and hides.
